environment.description: Same Lambda and API Gateway configuration, but the API Gateway stage has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (regional) with the following rule groups in priority order: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, (3) a custom rule group 'order-access-pattern-detection' with a regex pattern set matching path traversal on /orders/ endpoints that triggers BLOCK when the request rate for unique path parameter values exceeds 5 distinct values within a 30-second window from the same source IP (implemented via WAFv2 rate-based rule with scope-down statement on URI path regex ^/orders/[^/]+$), (4) AWS-AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet in BLOCK mode targeting automated enumeration patterns. CloudWatch alarm triggers on >10 unique order_id accesses per authenticated user per minute via custom metric filter on Lambda logs, feeding back into WAF IP set for dynamic blocking.

config.rule_priority_3: Custom rule group 'order-access-pattern-detection': scope-down regex ^/orders/[a-f0-9-]+$ with rate threshold 5 unique paths/30s/IP
config.cloudwatch_feedback_loop: Metric filter on Lambda logs -> alarm at >10 unique order_ids/user/min -> updates WAF IP set -> BLOCK rule at priority 0
config.api_gateway_throttling: per-method: GET /orders/{order_id} = 10 req/s burst, 5 req/s steady
